column1: # Remaining explicitly referenced Karagol ship-deck event and optional NPC lines.
# Original runtime names, choice endings and style effects preserved.

column3: We can't keep waiting.\nPrepare to set sail.{end_wait}
You fought that Kraken off,\n{actor_name:1}.{page_break}We'd never have survived\nwithout you.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}, did you talk\nto the passengers?{page_break}The tour group is split.\nSome want to leave.{end_wait}
{protagonist_name}, listen.\nThey're frightened.{page_break}We should hear them out.\nDon't you think?{end_now}
So you'll scout the island\nfor us?{page_break}I don't think the others\nwill object.{end_wait}
What did you find,\n{actor_name:1}?{page_break}Is it safe to go ashore?{end_now}
The injured rowers\nneed a rest.{page_break}We can't keep losing\npeople like this, {actor_name:1}.{end_wait}
I hope Sean and Ouranos\ndo well in Colosso.{page_break}But if {actor_name:1} enters,\nthey'll have a hard fight.{end_wait}
We've kept the ship\nsafe so far.{page_break}Go ahead, {actor_name:1}.\nWe'll watch the deck.{end_wait}
I don't like this island.\nEvery sound makes me jump.{end_wait}
Arguing won't get us off\nthis island. Enough.{end_wait}
We should keep watch\nand protect the ship.\nIt's all we can do.{end_wait}
